sequence.subject: Claude Opus 4.8 — production builder question
sequence.body:
Claude Opus 4.8 launched last week. We build production AI systems on Claude — RAG chatbots, AI agents, full-stack apps — for clients in fintech and data infrastructure.

As Anthropic formalizes its partner ecosystem ahead of an IPO, we'd like to be part of it. We've shipped 21+ production systems, all code public on GitHub.

Is there a certified builder track or partner program we should apply to?

Muhammed John, Axiora — muhammedjohn3@gmail.com
